title: Week 1 Self Check-In
instructions: This is a closed-note evaluation designed to check your understanding of the course and its expectations. You will have {time_limit} to complete the evaluation. I will let you know when to begin once I start the timer. This assessment must be completed individually, without any collaboration or assistance. Answer each question clearly.

questions.question: How many total points are available this semester across all assignments?
questions.answer: 1,000 points. (Final 32.5% · three midterms 25% · self check-ins 15% · collaborative check-ins 10% · labs 10% · drills 7.5%.)
questions.rubric: 3 pts for 1,000 (accept '1000'). 0 pts otherwise — single number, no partial credit.

questions.question: Labs: When is a lab due, and what must you submit (or completed) for it to be counted as complete or done?
questions.answer: Due: Wednesday of the following week at 11:59 PM (labs are weekly — 15 take-home labs, 10 points each, generative AI permitted). Submission: answer the lab questions on Canvas (the Canvas lab quiz) for the lab to count as complete.
questions.rubric: 2 pts for the correct due day/time — Wednesday of the next week at 11:59 PM (1 pt for 'weekly' with no day/time). 2 pts for stating that the lab is submitted/completed on Canvas (Canvas questions); 1 pt for anything else; 0 pts for blank.
questions.instructor_notes: Due day/time and Canvas submission are not yet written into the syllabus §7 'L Labs' (Due:/Submission: are blank) — add them there so students can find this.

questions.question: Drills: How often are drills assigned per week, and how are they graded (select one of these options: correctness, for completion, or both)?
questions.answer: About 4 drills per week, all term (~40 questions/week, 10 per drill; 5–20 minutes each). They are graded for COMPLETION (engagement), not correctness: Complete ≥90% of questions and practice time = full 7.5%; Substantial 75–89% = 5.625%; Partial 50–74% = 3.75%; Insufficient <50% = 0%.
questions.rubric: 2 pts for '~4 per week' (accept 3–5); 2 pts for 'completion' (accept 'engagement' / 'completion and practice time'). 0 of the 2 pts for 'correctness' or 'both'.
questions.instructor_notes: Syllabus §7 'D Drills' engagement table and §8 '~4 per week, all term'.

questions.question: How many midterm exams are there this semester?
questions.answer: Three midterm exams — Wednesday of weeks 5, 9, and 13 (plus a cumulative common final on Saturday, December 12).
questions.rubric: 4 pts for 'three' / '3'. 0 pts otherwise. Do not deduct if the student also mentions the final.
questions.instructor_notes: Syllabus §6–§7: ME1 week 5, ME2 week 9, ME3 week 13.

questions.question: Which city was Dr. Williams most excited about visiting this summer?
questions.answer: Kyoto, Tokyo, or Osaka (any is accepted).
questions.rubric: 1 pt extra credit for Kyoto, Tokyo, or Osaka. No partial credit.
questions.instructor_notes: From the day-one introduction; not on the syllabus.
